description:
In the far-off future of 20XX, the brilliant roboticist Dr. Otto Matton builds the two most advanced humanoid robots ever created: Zed and Zee. But when they learn that their purpose is to lead Matton's army of super bots to world domination, they rebel against their creator and his sinister ambitions. Now it's up to them to put a stop to Dr. Matton's schemes and prevent the world from falling into his hands!

Run, jump, and stomp through six colorful worlds of fast-paced, arcade-style action! Passwords allow you to pick up where you left off last time! Play solo or cooperatively with a friend, or settle your differences in the two-player Battle Mode!

• Play solo or team up! You can take on Dr. Matton's robotic hordes alone, but teaming up with a friend is even better!
• Six unique worlds! Save the city of Mechtropolis, dodge flying buzzsaws in the Wired Woods, and brave the heat of the Infernal Factory!
• A colorful cast of enemies! Relentless plasma tanks, flying luchador masks, and unpredictable robo-frogs are just some of the threats you'll encounter on your mission!
• Challenging boss encounters! You may be able to defeat Dr. Matton's army of grunts, but can you survive the massive Super Robots waiting for you at the end of each world?
• 2-Player Battle Mode! When you need a break from saving the world, challenge your friend to a match in Battle Mode and determine who the real robot master is!
• Genuine 8-bit action! Zed and Zee isn't just retro-"styled"—it's a real 8-bit game designed for 8-bit console hardware!
